$comment: The register strips (ADR-114): three reference first screens per theme, shot live at 1440x900 by `node scripts/capture-subpages.mjs --register` or taken from a local reference still, stacked top to bottom into <subject>.png. A `url` is shot and read (readings/<site>.json); a `file` is resized and top-cropped, with no live reading. Order is the order in the strip. The two `arcs-*` entries are LOCAL strips (ADR-118): the owner's game-UI references for the arcs instrument, composed into the IGNORED `_shots/arcs-instrument/` folder as JPEGs at their own aspect and attached as image 3 on the arcs overview and its kit only. They are third-party images and the repository is public, so they are never written where the ship opts pictures back into git; `--register --only arcs-monitor,arcs-log` rebuilds them from the files named here, which live in the same ignored folder.
